 Catalog administration bypasses the serving cache. Serving snapshots are immutable, keyed by bucket and tenant, and expire within 30 seconds of the read's start; an already in-flight read may finish later. A verified cached snapshot can serve until expiry, and failures never refresh it or substitute an empty catalog. R2's same-key write rate limit can leave reservation/finalization pending and return 503; status/recovery is required, with no rapid-publication or deployed latency guarantee. This catalog-only contract does not make slots, learning, reflex or a multi-document decision manifest atomic, and does not activate enrichment exports or satisfy customer immediate-effect acceptance.
 
+Current catalog GET, successful catalog validation, PUT, import/pull, rollback, recovery and human-approved enrichment publication also return `diagnostics` with `schema: 'catalog-registry-diagnostics/v1'`, `advisory: true`, `status`, `catalogRevision` (null for a validation candidate), and current `registry: {scope, source, revision, version}`. This diagnoses the exact response/committed catalog against an uncached tenant registry read, not a second catalog read. Only definite absence in an allowed demo scope uses explicit `compiled-default` revision0; missing customer configuration, corrupt/oversized data or a read failure yields `status: 'unavailable'`, registry source `unavailable`, null registry revision/version, and null warning counts/list. Optional diagnostics cannot turn an already committed publication into a failure.
+
+Available diagnostics contain `warningCount`, `omittedWarningCount` and at most50 `warnings`. `unknown_dimension` means an exact tag key is absent from the registry; `no_nonempty_registered_tags` means a piece has no nonblank value on a registered key. Only an absent own `contentType` tag can count the shared safe render-type fallback when a non-derived `contentType` dimension is configured; explicit empty tags do not fall back. Warnings use zero-based `pieceIndex` and, for unknown keys, `dimensionIndex`, a maximum64-code-unit `dimension` display and `dimensionTruncated` flag. Counts include all warning occurrences beyond the sample limit; IDs and tag values are not echoed. This is dimension membership/nonblank feedback, not value vocabulary, case/locale normalization, learning readiness or proof that an item cannot rank. Catalogs remain accepted under their existing schema. Historical reads and noncatalog responses are unchanged. Diagnostics are not persisted in receipts, may change on an idempotent retry as the current registry changes, and are not activation approval, an atomic catalog/registry snapshot or a serving-cache attestation.
+
